verdict.rationale: Grok Build documents programmatic control. Headless mode serves scripts and bots [docs-6], with `plain`, `json` or `streaming-json` output [docs-41]. It also runs as an ACP agent over JSON-RPC on stdin/stdout so other apps can drive it [docs-7, probe-rt-1], and a community user independently highlights headless mode plus full ACP support for custom bots and orchestration [comm-19]. Missing for 10: a network/REST API for Grok Build itself (the OpenAPI spec and xAI API cover the models, not the agent), in-depth ACP method/schema documentation in the evidence, and hands-on corroboration of driving it via ACP.
